title: The Dark Truth About Warhammer 40,000 Roleplay #Shorts
description:
Nothing in Warhammer 40,000 Roleplay was built for you — it was built for reproduction. Warhammer 40,000 Roleplay is a role-playing game system with multiple source books set within the Warhammer 40,000 universe. The first game using the system, Dark Heresy, was created by Black Industries, which closed soon after the initial release.

Behind Warhammer 40,000 Roleplay sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. The initial limited release sold out at the Gen Con 2009 event before a wider release to stores in October 2009. Deathwatch, the third Fantasy Flight RPG based in the Warhammer 40,000 universe was officially announced on 26 February 2010.
